text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян's second summer camp is
coming to
a close.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...I love the sound of the waves.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm sure it feels that way because
we have
peace of mind ourselves.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I didn't feel this way at the end of
summer camp
last year.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: But this year... I feel so at peace. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure that's because you were
watching me
this year.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text: I just really felt it this time...

text_block_list.text:
It's finally almost time for the Sprinters
Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I hope... you keep having eyes for no
one but me.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
She seems a little calmer and more
mature than
usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As this year's summer camp comes to an
end, I
can really feel how much she's
grown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
